items.title: Action Required: ArcGIS Online and Location Platform SAML Customers
items.summary: ArcGIS Online (and Location Platform) Organization administrators that have enabled Signed and/or Encrypted SAML Assertions in alignment with ArcGIS Online Best Practices for SAML Security must obtain the latest ArcGIS Online Service Provider metadata file + certificate and associate it with their Enterprise (SAML) Identity Provider (e.g. Entra ID Enterprise Applications ) before August 28, 2026 to ensure continued (SAML) login operations with ArcGIS Online.

items.title: EU AI Act enforcement begins today with new transparency rules
items.summary: The European Union’s artificial intelligence regulations enter their most consequential enforcement phase today, with the European Commission’s AI Office and national authorities beginning to enforce Article 50 of the AI Act a transparency mandate affecting millions of AI applications across the bloc and beyond.

items.title: EU rules on AI models become enforceable. What's going to change?
items.summary: As of today, the EU's rules on AI models become enforceable, cementing the European Commission's role as the world's most prominent regulator of this disruptive technology.

items.title: EU's New AI Transparency Rules Take Effect, But Enforcement Questions Linger
items.summary: The European Union's landmark artificial intelligence legislation crossed a critical threshold on August 2, 2026, when transparency obligations under Article 50 of the EU AI Act became binding.
